subject: I set something aside for you - expires tomorrow
preview_text: This is a 30-day user exclusive. It's a mistake to skip this. The offer disappears at midnight.
body_paragraphs: Okay, confession time. I was looking at the user list yesterday. I saw your name hit the 30-day mark. And I did something a little crazy.

I flagged your account. Manually. I set aside a special upgrade path that only unlocks for users who stick around for a month. It’s my way of saying thanks for not ghosting the app. The value stack is stupid: all premium features, priority support, and a permanent rate lock. But here’s the thing—it was only meant for this batch. The system purges these flags at midnight tomorrow.

This unlocks everything. The humanizer to make your paper undetectable. The one-click citation wizard. The export templates that make your PDFs look like a professor wrote them. It’s all live, right now, in your app settings under ‘Account’.

Tap the button. See the offer. It’s there. But only until the clock resets. This isn’t a fake timer. I’m literally turning this access off. P.S. The 50k students who pay full price? They never see this screen. Don’t be them.
